gradeSpan.notes: The district website describes current programs as TK-8; reconcile the CDE directory's K-8 label before publishing a normalized span.

languages.coverageRule: Measure availability and fallback per artifact; never infer district-wide parity.

vendor.name: California Department of Education
vendor.basis: Official CDE directory URL keyed by the district CDS entity code.

cadence.expectation: Check before identity or school-roster releases.

sources.archiveNotes: CDE warns that directory details are self-reported and may be stale.

vendor.name: Catapult CMS
vendor.basis: Official site exposes Catapult-style fallback paths, but a current vendor footer was not confirmed.

cadence.expectation: Monitor configured source pages rather than crawling the whole site.

sources.archiveNotes: The site exposes both friendly and internal fallback URLs for some pages.

vendor.name: Catapult CMS
vendor.basis: Same platform evidence as the official website; the page explicitly identifies Simbli and Agenda Online eras.

cadence.expectation: Use as the authoritative discovery bridge and check around each scheduled meeting.

sources.archiveNotes: Official page states Simbli coverage since April 2022 and Agenda Online coverage from May 2017 through March 2022.

vendor.name: Simbli
vendor.basis: Direct link from the official district governance page and stable Simbli site identifier.

cadence.expectation: Discover daily; reconcile around the board's typical second- and fourth-Thursday cadence.

sources.archiveNotes: Portal also contains committee meetings; primary-board consumers must filter by meeting type.

vendor.name: Agenda Online
vendor.basis: Direct link from the official district governance page.

cadence.expectation: Use for backfill and cross-regime reconciliation.

sources.archiveNotes: Official landing page describes May 2017 through March 2022 coverage; earlier records may exist elsewhere.

vendor.name: YouTube
vendor.basis: The official governance page identifies the Ravenswood Schools YouTube page as its livestream and recording source.

cadence.expectation: Discover after meetings and reconcile against both governance portals.

sources.archiveNotes: Confirm channel identity from the official page before automating; handle livestream and uploaded-video IDs separately.

vendor.name: Catapult CMS
vendor.basis: Official district page on the same candidate CMS.

cadence.expectation: Check at LCAP and budget adoption and when SARCs are published.

sources.archiveNotes: The page retains prior LCAP and bilingual SARC links; separate reporting years from publication years.

vendor.name: Google Calendar
vendor.basis: Official page exposes Google Calendar subscription controls.

cadence.expectation: Monitor event feeds and reconcile instructional dates to the approved calendar document.

sources.archiveNotes: District, school, and community calendars are distinct and must not be merged without source labels.

vendor.basis: Official Business Services page links to Child Nutrition, but the underlying menu platform was not verified.

cadence.expectation: Identify the live menu source before building an adapter.

sources.archiveNotes: Treat the landing page as discovery only until a menu platform and stable identifiers are confirmed.

sourceRegimes.notes: The district describes this range by month; do not invent day-level cutovers.
Official page says agendas since April 2022; the null end is an unknown future boundary.

sampleTargets.selection: Meetings across Agenda Online and Simbli, including regular, special, edited, and cancelled records where available.
Match agendas, attachments, minutes, revisions, cancellations, and YouTube recordings.
Separate instructional, district-event, school-event, and community-event feeds.
Discover the official menu platform and test at least one elementary and one middle-school menu.

successSignals: RCSD's Simbli and YouTube logic works from shared adapters plus this manifest.
No adapter contains a Ravenswood-specific district-name branch.
Cross-regime revisions and cancellations reconcile without collapsing distinct records.

openQuestions: Confirm the CMS vendor from a current first-party vendor marker before assigning a high confidence.
Identify the live Child Nutrition menu platform and stable organization or site identifiers.
Inventory governing committees represented in Simbli and decide which belong in pilot scope.
Determine whether any governance records before May 2017 remain available through an official archive.
